set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED_HTML=18770d8e333af1bc49a818da4dbd5c2e482b859e0142d0213df6c956184c931e
MASK=/var/tmp/go-avatar-eye-mask-shadow-v1/eye_identity_mask.png
OPEN=/var/tmp/go-avatar-eye-mask-shadow-v1/eye_identity_open.png
test "$(sha256sum buehne.html|awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED_HTML"
test "$(sha256sum "$MASK"|awk '{print $1}')" = 321ef6fa09c6dfb72ab9eb486d623b49d5a4e9c512ace80bfd09ef4e7f3867b0
test "$(sha256sum "$OPEN"|awk '{print $1}')" = 8ab1a11c6f8a738e34c516bbf65c00e0f48de70c7341bfa970f236e002c94fc9
test "$(find ausdruck_erweitert_relief2 -type f -path '*/frontal/stufe_*.png'|wc -l)" -eq 308
REL='anime_90s/anime_fassungslos/frontal/stufe_00.png'

HTTP=$(curl -fsS "http://127.0.0.1:8788/ausdruck_erweitert/$REL?authority=relief2"|sha256sum|awk '{print $1}')

python3 - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np,glob,hashlib
mask=np.asarray(Image.open('/var/tmp/go-avatar-eye-mask-shadow-v1/eye_identity_mask.png').convert('L'))
plate=np.asarray(Image.open('/var/tmp/go-avatar-eye-mask-shadow-v1/eye_identity_open.png').convert('RGBA'))
expr=sorted(glob.glob('ausdruck_erweitert_relief2/*/*/frontal/stufe_*.png'))
assert len(expr)==308,len(expr)
W,H=Image.open(expr[0]).size
x0=round(W*.31); y0=round(H*.12); pw=round(W*.27); ph=round(pw*mask.shape[0]/mask.shape[1])
rmask=np.asarray(Image.fromarray(mask).resize((pw,ph),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS))
rplate=np.asarray(Image.fromarray(plate).resize((pw,ph),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)).copy()
rplate[:,:,3]=(rplate[:,:,3].astype(np.uint16)*rmask.astype(np.uint16)//255).astype(np.uint8)
a=rplate[:,:,3].astype(np.float32)/255.0
core=rmask>=240; mid=rmask>=128; feather=(rmask>8)&(rmask<240)
before=[]; after=[]; outside_max=0
for p in expr:
 e=np.asarray(Image.open(p).convert('RGBA'))
 roi=e[y0:y0+ph,x0:x0+pw,:3].astype(np.float32)
 out=roi*(1-a[...,None])+rplate[:,:,:3].astype(np.float32)*a[...,None]
 before.append(roi); after.append(out)
 # construction changes only mapped alpha support; assert numerical identity where alpha is zero
 if (~(a>0)).any(): outside_max=max(outside_max,float(np.max(np.abs(out[~(a>0)]-roi[~(a>0)]))))
b=np.stack(before); c=np.stack(after)
def score(sel,name):
 sb=np.mean(np.std(b[:,:, :, :],axis=0)[sel])
 sa=np.mean(np.std(c[:,:, :, :],axis=0)[sel])
 red=(1-sa/sb)*100 if sb else 0.0
 print(name,'PIXELS',int(sel.sum()),'STD_BEFORE',round(float(sb),4),'STD_AFTER',round(float(sa),4),'REDUCTION_PCT',round(float(red),3))
 return red
r1=score(core,'CORE_A240'); r2=score(mid,'MID_A128'); score(feather,'FEATHER')
print('OUTSIDE_ALPHA_SUPPORT_MAX_DELTA',outside_max)
print('MAPPED_GEOMETRY',W,H,x0,y0,pw,ph)
print('RELIEF2_EXPRESSION_FRAMES',len(expr))
assert r1>95 and r2>90 and outside_max==0
print('RELIEF2_EXPRESSION_EYE_IDENTITY_VARIANCE_GATE=PASS')
PY
echo LIVE_WRITE=FALSE
echo SCOPE=READ_ONLY_PRODUCTIVE_RELIEF2_308_EXPRESSION_EYE_IDENTITY
